title: A Portfolio for a Client
usage: Every 'file' is relative to public/works/concept-portfolio/art/. In Vite use `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}works/concept-portfolio/art/${file}`. w/h are intrinsic pixel sizes. Slides are portrait 1080 x 1920 WebP; 'sheet' is the five slides side by side with 20 px ink gutters; 'thumb' is the cover at 700 px wide. Everything on the slides (name, studios, film titles, domain, phone number) is fictional.
label: Concept project - art-directed by Pau, built with AI-assisted tools

client.name: Ona Ribas
client.bio: Ona gives films their footsteps, rustling coats, slamming doors and sighs. For ten years she has worked in a studio full of gravel, celery and old shoes: first as a foley walker, then cutting foley for 22 films, and now performing it herself on features, series, shorts and games. She talks to directors in objects (“this scene is wet cardboard”) and keeps one very patient neighbour.

slides.title: Cover: Foley Portfolio
slides.alt: Teal cover: FOLEY PORTFOLIO in fat hand-lettered cream bubble letters with a tomato echo, above a giant furry boom microphone cut out like a sticker, with a yellow sunburst behind it and red SNAP! and CRUNCH! bursts. The tagline reads “The small noises that make a film feel real.”

slides.title: About: I’m Ona Ribas
slides.alt: Butter slide headed I’M ONA RIBAS in blue hand-cut letters over a yellow sunburst, with a short bio and five 3D-rendered foley props tagged with the noise they fake. Ona, in a lilac sweater and red dungarees, kicks one knee up and claps two coconut halves.

slides.title: Experience and education
slides.alt: Butter slide headed EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION in loaded-brush lettering: a deep-teal wall of pinned waveforms, a film strip, tickets and a cassette, with Ona at a mixing desk in yellow headphones and a speaker with a sleeping cat. Below, a footprint trail links four timeline entries from film school in 2012 to Casa Grava Studio today.
